signals.text: 2 open PM roles across 1 US office
1 new PM role posted this week

bullets: Understand Everand's readers deeply: what motivates them, why they stay, and why they leave. Use that understanding in every decision.
Set the vision, strategy, and roadmap for the app on iOS and Android, and own the reader experience on every surface, from first open to their next book.
Lead a squad of engineers, designers, researchers, and analysts, and own execution: set goals, make trade-offs, and ship well-made work on time.
Keep the reader experience human, grounded in readers' taste and the pleasure of reading. Work as an AI-native PM, using AI to speed up research, prototyping, analysis, and…
Decide where to invest by finding the biggest opportunities to make Everand more valuable, for current readers and for readers we don't reach yet.
Own the acquisition roadmap and decide where its engineering investment goes, adapting as the market shifts.
Develop and maintain a cross-channel view of where acquisition investment pays off, and bring a clear, evidence-backed recommendation to channel owners and leadership.
Build acquisition into the product itself, through referrals, sharing, and other experiences that help existing users bring in new ones.
Build and maintain the product capabilities that make each channel more effective, including discoverability, search and AI-answer-engine readiness, channel integrations, and…
Identify and test new ways to reach users and scale the ones that prove durable.
